Behind just a few seconds of animation lie hours of patience and precision. Are you old enough to remember these? Check out these adorable 1:16 scale Swanson TV dinners crafted for my 70s tiny kitchen! Swanson introduced the first TV dinner in 1953, featuring a full meal like turkey with stuffing or fried chicken in a compartmentalized aluminum tray, marketed as an easy, quick meal for families to enjoy while watching TV.
